all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved: coordinate order homeomorphism, inverse Jacobian and integral transport, actual absorption-CDF flux, transformed derivative away from traps, exact integration across trap sites, and absolute continuity of the transformed function of every single-interval weak state

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Existence/uniqueness of center, minimax and strict equality
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for positive continuous transformed weights: independently defined rise integrals, unique interior balancing point, attained minimax as IsLeast, strict loss at every other trial site, and iff equality. CellWeight.ofSource supplies every physical transformed weight from the verified coordinate construction

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Joint barrier continuity and strict decrease under cell splitting
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved on the full closed cell triangle: joint center/barrier continuity, zero barrier exactly on the diagonal, degenerate-cell minimax, strict improvement for both children of every interior split, and strict decrease for every nondegenerate proper subcell

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Lower bound for every site, including out-of-cell cases; equality conditions
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for every physical single-interval weak state at its independently defined Lebesgue essential norm: full height barrier including both out-of-cell cases; equality requires the balanced center and both cell-boundary values equal to the norm

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Strict decrease, existence, uniqueness, root bounds
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for positive finite weights and real barriers, and for nonnegative weights with zero barrier at zero weight: continuity, strict decrease, root existence, uniqueness, cell lower bounds, total-weight lower bound and maximum-barrier upper bound

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Positive strengths, exact budget, attaining profile and weak equation
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for every independently specified strict source partition and positive budget: ordered interior balanced sites, exact integral profile, boundary/trap values and height bound, physical gap equations and reaction jumps, positive exact-budget strengths, original H1 weak equation, attained physical essential norm equal to the scalar root, and recovery of the prescribed absorption partition

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Arbitrary-design lower bound via its absorption partition
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for every physical weak design with positive interior strengths: its actual absorption partition, strict barrier/norm separation, individual strength inequalities, summed budget bound, and existence/uniqueness of the partition root with T_K(q) no greater than the physical essential norm. Attaining construction is proved in I05; compact minimization and the global optimizer characterization are proved in I07–I08

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Continuous root on closed simplex; attained minimum; no zero cells
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved: genuine budget root continuous through zero-cell limits, compact closed partition space, attained minimum, adjacency of zero/positive cells, admissible boundary move with fixed count, strict root improvement, and strictness of every minimizing partition

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Equality of attained minima and complete optimizer converse
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for the independent physical H1 weak-design space: the physical cost and strict-partition root have the same attained least value; every minimizing partition constructs an optimal design; every optimal design has a minimizing absorption partition and the exact balanced position/strength formulas; the complete reconstruction iff uses weak uniqueness and physical norm congruence. Stochastic lifetime identification remains P04

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Existence/uniqueness of positive root and comparison bound

all_47_source_groups.source: Periodic consequence after `thm:spectral`; longer `eq:spectral-circle-gaps`, `cor:spectral-exner`; expanded ch. 7
all_47_source_groups.required_target: Periodic optimum and equality up to symmetry
all_47_source_groups.dependencies: Independent periodic foundation and periodic versions of E03–E07
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved analytically for arbitrary sorted distinct physical arrays on [0,L): independent periodic H1 Rayleigh model; positive attained principal value; full Rayleigh-class equality under rotation to the first trap; prescribed-strength attained maximum and exact site equality x_i = offset + optimalPrefix_i for the fixed cyclic order; fixed-budget equality iff all strengths are K/n and x_i = a + i L/n with 0 ≤ a < L/n. Every such rotation attains, and reflection permutes the regular array. Exner normalization gives the unique k in (0,n/2), alpha = 2k tan(pi k/n), attained value k², complete regular-array equality and strict loss otherwise. Full weak-equation equivalence under rotation, positive physical ground-state attainment and uniqueness up to scale for arbitrary arrays are also proved. General operator/eigenbasis and stochastic identifications remain B01/P05. See the periodic array and uniqueness reports

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Ordered-media comparison and Lipschitz bound at fixed `K/S`
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for fixed architecture and equal normalized budget K/S: reflecting and mixed reactive-endpoint barrier/root ordering, strict order for everywhere strict transformed-profile comparison, the fixed-partition bound εΔ²/2 and optimized physical bound ε/2 in the actual Lebesgue essential L∞ norm. The optimal value is defined independently from physical full-H1 states and attained. The earlier reflecting comparison also covers any common nonempty partition class, with attainment required for strict constrained comparison. See the mean and endpoint report

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Reactive endpoint classes, one-sided barriers, corresponding reconstruction
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for deterministic content: arbitrary fixed endpoint architecture, full-H1 weak foundations, positive absorption partition, exact physical minimax and parameters-only optimizer converse, with state equality derived from weak uniqueness. The homogeneous 2m+b sharp value, unique shares/strengths and all four position formulas are proved. Selecting one side is the attained minimum over the independent union of the two physical classes; symmetric transformed weights give equal side minima. Exact endpoint-only sharpness and quadratic profile examples, and full bidirectional normalized H1 weak equivalence with norm/share/partition invariance, are checked. Includes m=0; stochastic interpretation remains P04. See the endpoint and local perturbation report

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Strict Schur concavity, strength splitting, inverse cell-to-strength map
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for positive strengths: standard descending-prefix majorization at equal count and total compares the actual attained physical optima, strictly unless the vectors are permutations, for fixed L,D and fixed finite nonnegative Robin endpoint coefficients. Splitting one positive strength into two positive strengths at independently placeable distinct sites preserves total interior strength and strictly improves the physical optimum. The ordered cell/strength bijection, feasibility exactly kL < n pi, reconstructed unique maximizing sites and value Dk² are proved for Neumann endpoints, as stipulated by the source inverse theorem; no Robin inverse-cell bijection is claimed. General nondifferentiable Karamata and finite HLP are now proved in B01. See the strength-design and parallel foundations reports

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Robin offsets, root, construction and equality for fixed nonnegative coefficients
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for positive interior count, ordered positive strengths, positive L,D and fixed finite nonnegative endpoint coefficients: independent physical H1 Rayleigh minimum, positive attained ground state, full weak equation with both endpoint terms, exact phases/root/gaps/sites, constructive all-site maximum Dk², complete ordered-site optimizer iff and strict loss otherwise. Zero endpoint coefficients recover the Neumann problem exactly. With fixed interior data and each unselected endpoint held finite and fixed, one or both diverging coefficients give convergence of the actual moving roots, phases, scaled root squares and maximizing sites to the scalar Dirichlet formulas. Mass-normalized principal weak states have vanishing traces at diverging endpoints for fixed L,D,count, even when strengths/sites vary. Cosine states have peak 1 and endpoint values cos(B0), cos(BL); this differs from shooting normalization u(0)=1. Empty-interior checks are scalar identities, and the one-trap tangent equivalence retains 0 < kL < pi. A separately defined Dirichlet H1 spectral optimizer, whole-state/operator convergence and a zero-interaction physical extension are not claimed. See the parallel foundations report

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Reflected reference Brownian process and occupation local times
all_47_source_groups.dependencies: Audited Brownian construction, new local-time foundation
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for the exact reflected-reference source scope: the actual folded Brownian path has a genuine Brownian driver, reflecting regulators and the original reflected equation; its transition, generator, reversibility, cosine/L2 domain and strong Markov identifications are derived. The actual interior local time has the all-time Tanaka and occupation identities with Gamma=2D*ell, nonnegative continuous increasing time paths, atomless site-supported Stieltjes measure and literal Revuz delta_a relative to dx (delta_a/L for normalized dx/L). A spatially continuous C([0,T])-valued version and joint scalar measurability/continuity are constructed, with each fixed original site identified for all compact times on one event. Literal ordinary occupation bands divided by 2h converge almost surely for the full positive-radius limit, uniformly on every finite horizon. The actual fixed-site local time is a canonical Borel nonanticipating path functional, strongly adapted in the particle filtration; its path law is concentrated on a measurable shift-invariant good set, with the cocycle for every pair of nonnegative times. Only finite prescribed sites are required by the source, so no common uncountable raw-level equality is assumed. Generic semimartingale theory is not an additional source assertion. Physical rho-Revuz normalization remains P02.

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Resistance transform, time change, model identification and atomic normalization
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for the original physical interval model with continuous positive conductance a and speed rho: literal resistance coordinate/inverse, positive clock/inverse, continuously confined process, occupation density and exact physical band normalization, original contact strengths and carried atomless measures, physical conditional killing and full-H1 expected lifetime, original continuous value/flux/generator Neumann martingales, actual strong Markov property and complete continuous-path law uniqueness without a competitor Markov premise. Spatial transition continuity and actual paired-transition symmetry/invariance relative to rho dx are derived. The fixed-site canonical nonanticipating positive continuous additive functional has its own Stieltjes contact measure and the all-time cocycle on a measurable invariant full-measure good set. The exact identity integral rho*f*E[contact_g(T)] = g(a)*integral_0^T P_s f(a)ds and its short-time quotient limit f(a)g(a) are proved under the explicitly defined unnormalized rho dx measure. Thus its Revuz measure is exactly delta_a. The broad abstract Revuz correspondence is quoted background instantiated by this actual construction, as the source explicitly permits; no general symmetric-process correspondence is silently claimed. The separate expanded-source strictly positive-time interior hitting assertion is now proved in B01.

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Exponential-threshold killing and exact conditional survival identity
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for the actual physical resistance-time-changed process: reversibleResistanceAttainmentLifetime_particle_condExp gives the literal first-attainment survival conditional expectation given precisely the raw sigma-algebra generated by the full physical X path. Genuine physical band reconstruction supplies an AE measurable local-time representative in this smaller sigma-algebra; the independent exponential coordinate is excluded. The nested-sigma tower derives the original exp(-sum kappa ell) weight. Interior sites, arbitrary finite families including empty, nonnegative strengths, plateaus and infinite lifetime are retained. Process-law uniqueness and broader normalization remain separate P02/P01 obligations.

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Local-time Itô identity, expectation justification, finite/infinite-horizon limits
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for the displayed original interval source claim: reversibleResistanceSurvivalResolvent independently defines the expected infinite survival-weight integral; its full product/path/time integrability is derived, it equals every original WeakIntervalEquation solution, and reversibleResistanceSurvivalResolvent_weak_equation proves that equation for the expectation itself. The full H1 test space, original continuous positive a and rho, ordered interior sites, nonempty positive strength family and every-start physical statement are preserved. Actual reflected finite-kink Ito, weighted contact cancellation, finite and infinite signed running-cost limits, and literal threshold-stopped costs are proved. Reactive-endpoint physical means and full competitor-class lifetime optimization are also proved, including endpoint-only architectures. This row does not assert uniqueness for every abstract process specified only by a formal generator; that remains P02. The graph stochastic source interpretation is proved in P06.

all_47_source_groups.source: §6 long-time survival; expanded ch. 7 spectral design
all_47_source_groups.required_target: Actual killed semigroup/eigenfunction correspondence, logarithmic survival decay and the source second-eigenvalue survival expansion
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved: the actual killed L2 contraction, constructed independently from weighted expectations, equals the original weak operator spectral heat semigroup with full generator correspondence. The source initial-density spectral series is proved for every L2 weight. Every nonnegative nonzero density has a positive leading coefficient and a second-eigenvalue remainder bounded for all t>=0 by exp(-lambda2*t) times both orthogonal ground remainders, hence by exp(-lambda2*t)*norm(r)*sqrt(L). At every fixed physical start, including endpoints, literal first-attainment survival has the positive coefficient phi1(x)*integral(phi1) and an explicit second-rate bound for all t>=1. Strict first spectral gap and both BigO conclusions are derived. The actual logarithmic decay objective retains the sharp prescribed-strength and joint-budget optima, complete equality and attainment. See ReflectedInitialSurvivalExpansion and ReflectedAttainmentSurvivalExpansion.

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Kirchhoff graph diffusion, point local time, and graph expectation identity
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for the original positive-mass graph source scope: actual conservative continuous graph laws, canonical point local times, future-path conditioning, local-time cocycle/contact and ordinary-length unit-atom Revuz normalization; literal original-rho clock, continuous physical path law, inverse-clock local times and original killing strengths. physicalTransition_reversible proves full Borel detailed balance for the original unnormalized physicalSpeedMeasure, with invariance and no remaining symmetry premise. robinWeak_lifetime_mean identifies the literal first-exponential-threshold lifetime with every original full-H1 weak graph state at every vertex and closed-edge point; almost-sure finiteness and ordinary finite mean are derived. physicalMeanLifetime is independently defined, then physicalMeanLifetime_weak_equation and physicalMeanLifetime_unique prove its full source equation and uniqueness. Loops, parallel edges, passive leaves, positive continuous edgewise conductance/density and unequal incident density traces are retained. The graph is nontrivial (positive mass); no edgeless singleton, arbitrary abstract graph-process uniqueness, separate arbitrary physical stopping-time theorem or separate physical-rho graph Revuz limit is claimed. Exact source review: audit/graph-p06-final-source-audit.md; final evidence: audit/three-paper-closure-verification.json.

all_47_source_groups.dependencies: A01, G01–G02, source-coordinate and integral analysis
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for continuous positive edge profiles: exact physical source-coordinate cost reduction, strict convexity and a unique interior minimizing level, constructive local attainment, sharp ordinary and both passive-tip bounds with complete equality, and the variable-profile graph bound for actual weak states at their essential norm. The exact deficit is the sum of nonnegative reaction and profile-edge deficits; equality holds iff all reactive vertex values equal S/K and every edge satisfies its local equality conditions. Constant-profile formulas and the exact asymmetric affine example Ω(q) = 1 + q, including its unique minimizer and radical minimum, are proved. The equality characterization does not assert simultaneous attainment on every arbitrary graph. See the mean and profile report

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Attained optimum over geometry/reactivity and full equality allocations
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for unit source, positive fixed diffusivities, and feasible fixed passive leaves: independent design space, actual weak-state lower bound, positive exact-length construction, IsLeast with attainment, iff uniqueness of both labeled parameter vectors, and common-diffusivity/count formulas. The homogeneous ordered-interval optimum is independently proved in I09

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Exact spectral phase deficit and equality for admissible eigenfunctions
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved analytically for the interval: positive phase shares, exact tangent-half first/second derivatives and strict Jensen equality, sharp tangent-jump inequality and centered equality, exact two-part physical deficit, nonnegativity and separate zero conditions, zero total deficit iff equal strengths and midpoint sites, and strict positive deficit for every other admissible parameter pair. The shorter prescribed-strength deficit and its centered-phase equality iff are also proved

all_47_source_groups.required_target: Stated weak/strong-coupling and large-N limits, with their fixed parameters
all_47_source_groups.sealed_status: Proved for the attained interval and periodic physical optima: exact constant-trial ratio and strict bound; fixed positive K,D,L expansion K/L − K²/(12DN²) + K³L/(180D²N⁴) with O(N⁻⁶) remainder through natural counts; fixed positive N,D,L weak-budget expansion with O(K⁴) remainder and value/K limit 1/L; strict increase with K and strong-budget limit Dπ²N²/L². Analytic tangent remainders and inverse-series bounds justify the coefficients. The limiting number is now the independently attained H1 Rayleigh minimum of a perfect-absorber cell of length L/N and each mixed end cell of length L/(2N). General interacting Dirichlet/operator foundations remain B01; no operator convergence is inferred. See the parallel foundations report
